Class ByteArrayBuilder

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.backend.panama.ByteArrayBuilder
public final class ByteArrayBuilder extends Object
Efficient byte array builder optimized for terminal output.

This class is designed for the common case of ASCII escape sequences mixed with UTF-8 cell symbols. It avoids the overhead of StringBuilder followed by String.getBytes() by building the byte array directly.

ASCII operations (escape sequences, integers) write bytes directly. UTF-8 operations (cell symbols) encode only when necessary.

      public ByteArrayBuilder csi()

    • appendAscii

      public ByteArrayBuilder appendAscii(String s)
      Appends an ASCII string without charset encoding.

      This method assumes the string contains only ASCII characters (0-127). It is faster than appendUtf8(String) for escape sequences and other ASCII-only content.

      Parameters:
      s - the ASCII string to append
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • appendInt

      public ByteArrayBuilder appendInt(int value)
      Appends a non-negative integer as ASCII digits.

      This method converts the integer directly to ASCII digit bytes without creating intermediate String objects.

      Parameters:
      value - the non-negative integer to append
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • appendUtf8

      public ByteArrayBuilder appendUtf8(String s)
      Appends a UTF-8 encoded string.

      Use this method for cell symbols which may contain multi-byte UTF-8 characters (box-drawing, CJK, emoji, etc.).

      Optimized for the common case of ASCII-only strings to avoid the overhead of String.getBytes(java.nio.charset.Charset).

      Parameters:
      s - the string to append as UTF-8
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets the builder for reuse.

      This method clears the position but retains the allocated buffer for efficient reuse across frames.

      public byte[] toByteArray()
      Creates a new byte array containing only the valid data.
